variants.fwd-spread/ch: forward: the request's own spread per channel and layer (6 bits each, sent)
variants.fwd-bias+spread/ch: forward: the request's own bias (8 bits) and spread (6 bits) per channel and layer, sent
variants.fwd-spread/head: forward: one spread scale per head and layer (6 bits each, sent)
variants.bwd-pilot8: backward: bias and spread per channel measured on every 8th token, decoded first (nothing sent)

one-step (float).note: layer l-1 only: T's predictor before 8-bit rounding

anchor: most recent occurrence.note: + layer l at the token's most recent earlier occurrence (waves = longest repeat chain)

anchor: first occurrence.note: + layer l at the first occurrence; 2 waves

anchor: nearest key frame, K=8.note: key frames t % 8 == 0 first; others + layer l of the key frame nearest in layer l-1; 2 waves

anchor: nearest key frame, K=4.note: as K=8 with key frames t % 4 == 0

classes: repeated tokens.note: first occurrences and repeats separate predictors, no anchor input (decoder knows)

classes: k-means of layer l-1, k=4.note: decoder assigns each token by its decoded layer l-1 (no side bits)

classes: encoder picks 1 of 2.note: 2 predictors (k-means start, one refit); 1 bit per token and layer sent

classes: encoder picks 1 of 4.note: 4 predictors; 2 bits per token and layer sent
